front.title: Forwarding-Plane Failure Recovery Procedures for Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Groups

abstract.t: When a downlink member of a Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Group (MC- LAG) fails, a common recovery method flushes the MAC forwarding table and relies on flooding to re-establish the forwarding paths, which can cause a period of congestion and disruption. This document specifies two complementary forwarding-plane failure recovery procedures for MC-LAG. The first procedure preserves the forwarding state by adjusting the LAG group's member set, adding an inter- chassis link (ICL) port in place of the failed downlink, so that MAC table entries remain valid and traffic is redistributed without a table flush and without flooding. The second procedure extends recovery beyond a single Provider Edge (PE) pair: when the immediate peer cannot satisfy a failover request, the request is relayed over a secondary ICL to the next PE along a configured relay path, which allows recovery across three or more PEs in the redundancy domain. The procedures operate primarily in the forwarding plane and do not require Ethernet VPN (EVPN) infrastructure.
